jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a) inventory: Hartland School District, a town school district in the Windsor Southeast Supervisory Union (member town: Hartland).

sources.note: Hartland School Board page (Windsor Southeast SU, official): five directors -- Heather Vonada (Chair, 2027), Ryan Pezanowski (Vice Chair, 2028), Bethann Swartz (Clerk, 2027), Anthony Wilson (2027), Amanda Charland (2027). The board is five directors at-large (16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b): three 3-year seats, two 2-year seats -- Town Report 2026 officials list). Vonada was elected March 4, 2025 to the 2-year seat (443 votes, official abstract in Town Report 2026); Pezanowski was re-elected March 3, 2026 to the 2-year seat (his printed end moves 2026 to 2028).
